# Playtest save codes

Paste one into **Menu → Save Code → Restore** to jump straight to that part of
the game instead of replaying what comes before it. Each one has been loaded
back and verified.

Restoring overwrites the save on that device, so export your own first if you
care about it.

Regenerate these after any change to the save shape:

```sh
NODE_PATH=/opt/node22/lib/node_modules node tools/save-codes.js
```
